From 73a798711314b54cbd4fe224e24db92c306a8d8c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mika Kuoppala <mika.kuoppala@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Dec 2016 14:26:20 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Fix setting of boost freq tunable

For limiting the max frequency of gpu, the max freq tunable
is not enough to hard limit the max gap. We now have also per
client boost max freq. When this tunable was introduced,
it was mistakenly made read only. Allow user to gain control by
setting it writable.

Fixes: 29ecd78d3b79 ("drm/i915: Define a separate variable and control for RPS waitboost frequency")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v4.9+
Cc: Chris Wilson <chris@chris-wilson.co.uk>
Cc: Mika Kuoppala <mika.kuoppala@intel.com>
Cc: Daniel Vetter <daniel.vetter@intel.com>
Cc: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Chris Wilson <chris@chris-wilson.co.uk>
Signed-off-by: Mika Kuoppala <mika.kuoppala@intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1481718380-9170-1-git-send-email-mika.kuoppala@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_sysfs.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_sysfs.c
index b99fd9668317..40c0ac70d79d 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_sysfs.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_sysfs.c
@@ -460,7 +460,7 @@ static ssize_t gt_min_freq_mhz_store(struct device *kdev,
 
 static DEVICE_ATTR(gt_act_freq_mhz, S_IRUGO, gt_act_freq_mhz_show, NULL);
 static DEVICE_ATTR(gt_cur_freq_mhz, S_IRUGO, gt_cur_freq_mhz_show, NULL);
-static DEVICE_ATTR(gt_boost_freq_mhz, S_IRUGO, gt_boost_freq_mhz_show, gt_boost_freq_mhz_store);
+static DEVICE_ATTR(gt_boost_freq_mhz, S_IRUGO | S_IWUSR, gt_boost_freq_mhz_show, gt_boost_freq_mhz_store);
 static DEVICE_ATTR(gt_max_freq_mhz, S_IRUGO | S_IWUSR, gt_max_freq_mhz_show, gt_max_freq_mhz_store);
 static DEVICE_ATTR(gt_min_freq_mhz, S_IRUGO | S_IWUSR, gt_min_freq_mhz_show, gt_min_freq_mhz_store);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_sysfs.c`**
   - The `gt_boost_freq_mhz` device attribute was modified to change its permissions from read-only (`S_IRUGO`) to read-write (`S_IRUGO | S_IWUSR`). This allows users to set the boost frequency for the GPU, which was previously restricted.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the `i915_sysfs.c` file directly addresses the issue of user control over the boost frequency tunable for the GPU. By making the `gt_boost_freq_mhz` writable, it enables users to adjust the boost frequency, thereby fixing the bug where the tunable was mistakenly set to read-only. This modification is part of a broader effort to enhance GPU frequency management, as indicated by the context of the patch and the associated fix for a previous commit.

The root cause of the bug was that the `gt_boost_freq_mhz` tunable, which is intended to allow users to control the maximum boost frequency of the GPU, was mistakenly set as read-only. This prevented users from adjusting the boost frequency, limiting their ability to manage GPU performance effectively.
